display_long_description:
Welcome to ChaosShop—the VR game where you build a supermarket empire through farming and absolute fun.

🛒 Be the Boss of Your Own Store
You’re not a shopper or cashier—you’re the owner.   Decide what to sell, how to price items, and even slip regulars a “surprise gift.”   It’s your store, your rules.

🌾 Farm, Process, Sell—Your Complete Supply Chain
Grow crops on your own farm and turn them into products using machines like jam makers and fryers.   Create what you sell and build a self-sufficient business.

🎁 Surprises Around Every Corner

Mystery Gifts: Get random gift boxes with outfits, recipes, and decor.

Scratch Cards: Try your luck for instant cash prizes.

Interactive Checkout: Upsell items or give free gifts—each choice changes the outcome.

⚙️ Start Hands‑On, Then Automate
Begin by doing everything yourself, then unlock auto‑restockers and self‑checkout as you grow.   Spend more time decorating your store or just having fun in your own space.

👤 Customize Everything—Including Yourself
Change your look anytime and design your store with tons of decorations.   Your style, your personality, your supermarket.

🔜 Play With Friends
Team up in 4‑player co‑op to farm, produce, run checkout, or just create chaos together.

More than a game—it’s your playful, creative, mischievous supermarket sandbox.   Welcome to the chaos.   We’ve got you covered.

❤Love it?Join our Discord to share your ideas: https://discord.gg/vf4Vuuy4zv
